    | text      = Well we're gonna find out.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:12.000
    | text      = Did we start another war?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = It's not a war although a war will be mentioned.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:19.120
    | text      = Oh okay.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = Charlie Wilson.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:21.440
    | text      = So here we are Jordan.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:23.039
    | text      = Boston.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:23.840
    | text      = Yep.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:24.240
    | text      = Bean town.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:26.240
    | text      = The home of Fenway.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:27.440
    | text      = Yes yep.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:32.080
    | text      = We all know that.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:32.639
    | text      = Is the city of Boston?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:34.240
    | text      = Yeah okay.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:35.039
    | text      = The home of CT from the Real World Road Rules Challenge.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:37.919
    | text      = True.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:40.399
    | text      = True.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:40.799
    | text      = Is CT here?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:44.879
    | text      = Uh that's too bad.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:46.720
    | text      = What's he gonna do from the...
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:48.399
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:49.759

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = Good on you.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:52.639
    | text      = Thanks CT.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:53.679
    | text      = So there's a lot to say about this city so choosing a date to cover was no small feat.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:57.519
    | text      = I do think that one thing that immediately comes to mind when you think about Boston
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:01.039
    | text      = though is a good old tea party.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:03.360
    | text      = Okay all right.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:04.639
    | text      = So I decided to try and find an episode on the anniversary of the Boston Tea Party.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:09.759
    | text      = Sure.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:10.320
    | text      = They all sucked.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:11.279
    | text      = Okay.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:11.779
    | text      = So I tried a couple more dates related to the Boston Tea Party and they all sucked.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:16.899
    | text      = True.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:18.100
    | text      = So I figured you know if I was going to do an episode about this I was going to have
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:20.899
    | text      = to dig a little bit deeper right.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:22.899
    | text      = So the Tea Party was carried out in part by a group called the Sons of Liberty and I told
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:26.580
    | text      = myself I bet that if I look through the list of people who were members of that group we
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:32.019
    | text      = were going to find some fun names.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:33.700
    | text      = And I was right.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:41.860
    | text      = Fitch Poole.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:44.419
    | text      = William Carolina Cattle Esquire.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:47.539
    | text      = Ebenezer Clap.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:49.539
    | text      = Oh now that's a disease.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:51.940
    | text      = That's a disease.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:53.620
    | text      = Ah this motherfucker's stingy and he's whoa.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:56.820
    | text      = There were so many Ebenezer Clap.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:59.139
    | text      = I wonder what made the name go out of style.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:05.139
    | text      = And then Henderson Inches.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:07.620
    | text      = Henderson Inches.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:09.620
    | text      = I think Inches Henderson sounds better.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:11.860
    | text      = I think so too.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:12.340
    | text      = That's like a mob name.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:13.139
    | text      = Oh shit you've seen Inches around?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:16.500
    | text      = He killed three people last week.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:18.500
    | text      = You give him an inch he takes a mile.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:22.500
    | text      = Oh man.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:23.460
    | text      = Right.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:23.960
    | text      = No no no no no we've been working on puns all day.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:30.460
    | text      = We've been walking around Boston.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:32.460
    | text      = This is your fault.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:34.460
    | text      = It is true it is true.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:36.460
    | text      = Like over lunch I made a pun and Jordan looked at me weird and I was like I'm warming up
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:40.460
    | text      = man.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:42.460
    | text      = Gotta get in game shape.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:44.460
    | text      = Gotta keep going.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:46.460
    | text      = So I liked all those names and they were strong and some of them I looked into dates related
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:50.460
    | text      = to them in those episodes also.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:52.460
    | text      = So then I found a great name though.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:54.460
    | text      = A real weird one.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:56.460
    | text      = Hercules Mulligan.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:58.460
    | text      = That's a hell of a name.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:00.460
    | text      = Demigod Do-Over.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:02.460
    | text      = Yeah that's when you really fucked up.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:04.460
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:06.460
    | text      = So I wanted to see if I could learn a little bit more about this guy and turns out Hercules
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:10.460
    | text      = Mulligan was a wild figure in the American Revolution.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:12.460
    | text      = Sounds right.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:14.460
    | text      = He was an Irish guy who came to New York City in 1774 and said that Hercules was a wild
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:18.460
    | text      = figure in the American Revolution.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:22.460
    | text      = His business thrived, especially among the British living in the colonies, and he got
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:26.460
    | text      = in good with that whole world, even marrying the Admiral of the Royal Navy.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:29.460
    | text      = What?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:31.460
    | text      = However, the whole time he harbored revolutionary inclinations and opposed the British.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:35.460
    | text      = Harbored both!
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:38.460
    | text      = Keep going.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:40.460
    | text      = That's too old.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:42.460
    | text      = When the war broke out he was perfectly situated to be a spy for Washington DC.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:45.460
    | text      = Since he was fitting all the British soldiers with clothes and hats.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:48.460
    | text      = Legit, these dum-dums would tell their tailor everything, like literally spilling the beans
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:52.460
    | text      = on secret plots to capture Washington.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:56.460
    | text      = 3-0!
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:59.460
    | text      = After the war, Hercules was widely lauded as Washington's own clothes guy, and apparently
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:04.460
    | text      = he appears as a character in Hamilton, which I've never seen.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:07.460
    | text      = Which might be why there was an applause for Hercules Mulligan.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:10.460
    | text      = That makes sense.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:12.460
    | text      = Because otherwise I have no idea.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:15.460
    | text      = It's a great story of a tailor turned spy, but also fuck him because the only reason
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:19.460
    | text      = he was able to convey secret intelligence to Washington is because he sent a person
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:22.460
    | text      = he enslaved to do it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:25.460
    | text      = As with all these stories in American history, we need a mulligan.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:29.460
    | text      = I was going to say...
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:32.460
    | text      = 3-1?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:35.460
    | text      = Oh my god, the audience has spoken.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:39.460
    | text      = That was unfair.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:42.460
    | text      = That one was intended, that one was way in advance.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:45.460
    | text      = So we're going to celebrate, unfortunately I looked at every day anniversary of his birth
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:49.460
    | text      = and they were all bad.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:52.460
    | text      = So unfortunately we're going to celebrate the day he died.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:56.460
    | text      = The anniversary of Hercules Mulligan's death.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:59.460
    | text      = Oh my god.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:02.460
    | text      = The anniversary of Hercules Mulligan's death.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:09.460
    | text      = So are you ready to jump in?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:11.460
    | text      = Let's do it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:14.460
    | text      = Alright, here's where we start off with March 4th, 2011.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:19.460
    | text      = The sheening of America in less than a week troubled actor Charlie Sheen becomes
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:24.460
    | text      = country's top pop culture icon.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:27.460
    | text      = And they've done different analyses and breakdowns.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:29.460
    | text      = He's bigger than John Wayne, bigger than Marilyn Monroe.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:32.460
    | text      = And it's because he's not being a hypocrite.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:35.460
    | text      = I don't endorse everything he's saying or doing.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:38.460
    | text      = But he is my friend and he's been going through a lot.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:40.460
    | text      = And the point is, he's saying I'm going to be 100% real and I'm not going to be a hypocrite.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:44.460
    | text      = And that's what people recognize and appreciate is the truthfulness.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:49.460
    | text      = And it's just getting bigger and bigger and crazier by the minute.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:53.460
    | text      = I talked a lot to Charlie yesterday, talked to him this morning.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:57.460
    | text      = And I just hope this whole thing ends well.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:00.460
    | text      = Oh, it doesn't.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:04.460
    | text      = We live in the future now.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:05.460
    | text      = Spoiler alert, does not end well.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:08.460
    | text      = So in case anyone doesn't remember, 2011 was the year when Charlie Sheen had his huge meltdown.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:13.460
    | text      = He got fired from Two and a Half Men and became a ridiculous public spectacle.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:16.460
    | text      = Everyone had fun watching the train wreck he was living until they didn't and it became very sad.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:21.460
    | text      = What people tend to forget is that all of that happened because of an interview on Infowars.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:26.460
    | text      = Well, at least a lot of it did.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:27.460
    | text      = Right, right, right. It started there.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:29.460
    | text      = Sheen was talking to Alex when he got all anti-Semitic about Chuck Lorre and started his public spiral.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:34.460
    | text      = People may remember the 2020 interview that he did where he had like Tiger Blood and all that shit.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:38.460
    | text      = Yeah, yeah, yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:39.460
    | text      = But Two and a Half Men was canceled directly after he was on Infowars.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:43.460
    | text      = It would be a stretch to say that Alex was partially responsible for what happened to Sheen.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:47.460
    | text      = But he was definitely enabling him and being a bad friend because being a bad friend is good for business.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:53.460
    | text      = Because of his proximity to the story, Alex did a round of interviews including going on The View
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:57.460
    | text      = as he tried to cash in on this downfall.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:59.460
    | text      = Sure, yeah, yeah, yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:00.460
    | text      = It's pretty gross as a little patch of history to look back on and it only gets worse the more you know about it so let's not dwell on it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:06.460
    | text      = Yeah, let's never.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:07.460
    | text      = To give a little bit of sense of where things are at this point though on March 4th,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:11.460
    | text      = the initial interview that led to Two and a Half Men getting canceled took place on February 24th.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:16.460
    | text      = So we're about a week away from that.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:18.460
    | text      = Charlie has done some interviews and he's had his kids removed from his custody
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:21.460
    | text      = and then started tweeting a bunch of nonsense like,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:23.460
    | text      = winning!
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:25.460
    | text      = We all remember that?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:26.460
    | text      = I think at this point there really should be like a counter that shows up right there that goes like,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:31.460
    | text      = seven days away.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:35.460
    | text      = And then over to six days away.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:39.460
    | text      = So he's about a week away from announcing his Violent Torpedo of Truth tour.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:43.460
    | text      = Yes.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:44.460
    | text      = Which I don't know if you remember that.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:45.460
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:46.460
    | text      = That began with him getting blued off stage in Detroit on opening night.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:49.460
    | text      = I would say, I would say, and I'm just gonna throw this out there,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:53.460
    | text      = Violent Torpedo is not necessarily a great tour name.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:57.460
    | text      = But what if it's of truth?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:59.460
    | text      = Okay, never mind. I'm back in. Let's go!
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:02.460
    | text      = It was all bad times.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:04.460
    | text      = But it turns out, if you know anything about this,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
